biography: Born in the small coastal town of Uddevalla, Sweden, Charles Wilson's racing journey began not on asphalt, but on frozen lakes. His father, a former ice racer, introduced him to the art of controlling a car sideways before he even had a driver's license. Wilson would spend countless hours practicing Scandinavian flicks and throttle control on the icy surfaces, developing a remarkable feel for car balance. His transition to circuit racing was swift. After winning the Swedish Junior Karting Championship in 2021, he made the bold decision to bypass traditional racing ladders and compete as an independent driver in Formula Nordic. Though lacking the resources of larger teams, Wilson's raw talent and aggressive driving style quickly turned heads. Currently, he's campaigning in Formula Nordic, using his ice-racing background to excel in wet conditions, hoping to catch the eye of a bigger team.
drivingStyle: Wilson's driving style is characterized by a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to send it into corners, often flirting with the edge of grip. While this aggression can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also results in occasional mistakes. He favors a loose car setup, allowing him to rotate the car mid-corner, making him particularly adept at adapting to changing track conditions. Tire management is an area he's actively working to improve, as his initial exuberance often leads to excessive wear towards the end of races.

rivalries.reason: A fellow Swede and title contender in Formula Nordic, Dahlstrom represents the establishment, with a well-funded team, clashing with Wilson's independent spirit.

Another Formula Nordic competitor. Rossi and Wilson are known for their aggressive on-track battles, often resulting in close calls and the occasional bit of panel-bashing. Their intense rivalry has become a fan favorite.
Volkov, a stoic Finn, criticized Wilson's flashy driving style as 'unnecessary risk'. Wilson dismissed Volkov as a 'boring points accumulator', sparking a personal feud.

quirks: Always wears a lucky blue wristband gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to Swedish punk rock at full volume before every race to get pumped up.
Insists on personally polishing his helmet visor before each session, believing it improves visibility.
famousQuote: You gotta send it! Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the wet race at Kinnekulle Ring in 2023, after starting from the back of the grid, showcasing his car control and overtaking prowess in treacherous conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap at Mantorp Park in 2022, costing him a potential victory and a significant hit to his championship aspirations.
